create_websocket_manager: create a singleton WebSocketManager to manage socket.io connections for sending visualization updates
emit_status_update: emit a status_update event to the web interface with the current active agent and component info
patch_visualizers: patch StatusVisualizer and ProgressVisualizer classes to add web interface support via monkey-patching
create_web_status_adapter: create a WebStatusAdapter to wrap a StatusVisualizer and send agent status updates to the web
create_web_progress_adapter: create a WebProgressAdapter to wrap a ProgressVisualizer and send component progress updates to the web
